relationships.subject: pulsed radiofrequency
relationships.evidence_quote: With regards to nociceptive signalling, PRF treatment modulates ion channels (Na/K ATPase, HCN, P2X3), CGRP, neurotransmitters (aspartate, citrulline, M-ENK, glutamate), postsynaptic receptors (AMPA-R, GABA-B), and synaptic function (KCC2).

relationships.subject: pulsed radiofrequency
relationships.evidence_quote: PRF treatment also modulates immune activity, including microglial markers (CD3, CD56, Iba1), inflammatory cytokines (IL-6, IL-17, IRF8, IFN-g, TNFa), and intracellular proteins implicated in immune mediated neuropathic pain (BDNF, b-catenin, JNK, p38, ERK1/2).

key_findings: Review: PRF modulates ion channels, CGRP, KCC2, BDNF and immune markers; findings are mostly associations rather than causal.
